# ezghcloud_certificate_domain_authorization (Resource)

Permission for the organization to get Web Certificates for a domain and its subdomains. Set dns_zone_id to have EZGH write the validation records into one of your EZGH DNS zones; otherwise add the records in dns_instructions yourself.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ezghcloud_certificate_domain_authorization" "example" {
  domain_name = "example.com"
  dns_zone_id = ezghcloud_dns_zone.main.id # omit to add the dns_instructions records yourself
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_name` (String) Domain name to authorize, in lowercase without a trailing dot (punycode for other scripts). Changing it replaces the authorization.

### Optional

- `dns_zone_id` (String) EZGH DNS zone (zon_) that receives the validation records. Removing it unlinks the zone and removes the records EZGH wrote.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether certificates can be issued for the domain. Defaults to true.
- `name` (String) Name, 1 to 100 characters. Defaults to the domain name.
- `tags` (Map of String) Resource tags.

### Read-Only

- `dns_instructions` (Attributes List) The records that prove control of the domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dns_instructions))
- `id` (String) Domain authorization ID (dau_).
- `managed_dns` (Attributes) State of the records EZGH writes into the linked zone, or null when no zone is linked. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--managed_dns))
- `status` (String) pending until the validation records are seen, then verified.

<a id="nestedatt--dns_instructions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dns_instructions`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Record name.
- `type` (String) Record type.
- `value` (String) Record value.


<a id="nestedatt--managed_dns"></a>
### Nested Schema for `managed_dns`

Read-Only:

- `detail` (String) Why the records failed, when they did.
- `status` (String) synced, pending or failed.
- `zone_id` (String) The linked zone.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import ezghcloud_certificate_domain_authorization.example dau_xxxxxxxxxxxx
```
